lines.text: The temple and altar are to be measured, and the two witnesses prophesy 1,260 days in sackcloth.
Fire from the witnesses' mouths devours their enemies, and they can turn the waters into wine.
The beast kills the two witnesses, and their bodies lie in the street for three and a half days.
The breath of life from God enters the witnesses, they rise to heaven, and a third of the city collapses.
The seventh angel sounds his trumpet, the elders worship God, and the ark of His covenant appears in His temple.
